name: Major Project Part-I
description: Project type activity. Students work independently on a transportation engineering problem by reviewing related studies, identifying data requirements, and collecting relevant primary and secondary data. The students are also required to conduct relevant tests/simulation/modelling exercises, and interpret their outcomes with respect to the problem definition. It is also required to write technical reports and make presentations on work progress.
